table.name: AREA_CODE_STATE
table.purpose: Lookup table mapping North American telephone area codes to the US state (or territory) they belong to. One row per area code (305 rows, 201-989 range).

area_code.name: area_code
area_code.description: North American telephone area code (e.g. 201, 202, 203). Primary key of the table.

state.name: state
state.description: Two-letter US state/territory code (e.g. CA, TX, FL) that the area code belongs to. Many area codes map to one state.

table.name: CONTESTANTS
table.purpose: Roster of contestants in a voting contest (11 contestants). One row per contestant.

contestant_name.name: contestant_name
contestant_name.description: Full name of the contestant (first and last name).

contestant_number.name: contestant_number
contestant_number.description: Contestant's identifying number, 1-11. Primary key, referenced by VOTES.contestant_number.

table.name: VOTES
table.purpose: Individual votes cast for contestants, apparently by phone (each vote records a phone number, state and timestamp). One row per vote; only 4 rows present, likely a sample.

contestant_number.name: contestant_number
contestant_number.description: Number of the contestant being voted for; references CONTESTANTS.contestant_number.

created.name: created
created.description: Timestamp when the vote was recorded, format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (all votes on 2018-03-09).

phone_number.name: phone_number
phone_number.description: 10-digit US telephone number of the voter (e.g. 7182887233). Its first 3 digits are an area code that could be joined to AREA_CODE_STATE.

state.name: state
state.description: Two-letter US state code of the voter (NY, CA, NJ). Note one value has a trailing newline ('NJ\n'), indicating dirty data. Likely derived from the phone number's area code.

vote_id.name: vote_id
vote_id.description: Surrogate primary key of the vote record (values 1,2,3,5 - not fully contiguous).
